english.title: Sell and deliver / arrange delivery of bladed product to residential premises
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to section 38(2) and (8a) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) 'bladed product' is defined in section 41(1) as an article which is or has a blade or is capable of causing serious injury to a person which involves cutting that persons skin.
(ii) 'bladed product' does not apply to flick knives, gravity knives or an order made by the Secretary of State under section 141(A)(3)(c) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.
(iii) 'residential premises' means premises used solely for residential purposes and not where a person carries on a business from the premises as defined in section 38(5) and 38(6).
(iv) A similar offence to this as to delivery to a lockable container under section 38(3) is given in H20422.
(v) Defences are available at section 40(1-6).
(vi) Please note the transitional requirement in regulation 3 of SI 2022/418 – stating this offence does not apply where, before 6th April 2022, the seller arranges for the delivery of a bladed product and the delivery has not taken place by that date.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
